name: VisLit VLM Eval
description: This repository contains Jupyter Notebooks, prompts, and evaluation setups for assessing visualization literacy in Visual Language Models (VLMs). Benchmarks include VLAT and CALVI, comparing GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and Llama 3.2-vision at temperature 0 and max_tokens of 300.
